answer: A secure enclave key age with device attestation works as the gate: a key born in the enclave years ago. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The pearl signal separates the two cases at a glance: Each of 566 aliases needs its own authority-backed record, and the live check behind each one makes bulk forgery cost more than the reward. The sonnet ledger records each payment, the terrace window resets the board, and 566 fakes never beat one honest agent on price.
